title: User
description: Represents an Azure Active Directory user account. Inherits from directoryObject. Contains the user's profile information, organizational hierarchy, assigned licenses, and managed resources.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user. Inherited from directoryObject. GUID format.

displayName.description: The name displayed in the address book for the user.

givenName.description: The given name (first name) of the user.

surname.description: The user's surname (family name or last name).

mail.description: The SMTP address for the user. This property cannot contain accent characters.

userPrincipalName.description: The user principal name (UPN) of the user. The UPN is an Internet-style login name based on RFC 822. By convention, this should map to the user's email name.

department.description: The name of the department in which the user works.

officeLocation.description: The office location in the user's place of business.

companyName.description: The company name associated with the user.

businessPhones.description: The telephone numbers for the user.

mobilePhone.description: The primary cellular telephone number for the user.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the user's place of business.

city.description: The city in which the user is located.

state.description: The state or province in the user's address.

postalCode.description: The postal code for the user's postal address.

country.description: The country or region in which the user is located; for example, US or UK.

preferredLanguage.description: The preferred language for the user. Should follow ISO 639-1 Code; for example en-US.

accountEnabled.description: True if the account is enabled; otherwise, false. Required when creating a user.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time the user was created in ISO 8601 format.

lastSignInDateTime.description: The date and time of the user's most recent interactive or non-interactive sign-in.

usageLocation.description: A two-letter country code (ISO 3166) required for users who will be assigned licenses. Not nullable.

identities.description: Represents the identities that can be used to sign in to this user account.

assignedLicenses.description: The licenses assigned to the user.

memberOf.description: The groups, directory roles, and administrative units the user is a member of.
